fato_historico: 1934: A large typhoon hits western Honshū, Japan, killing more than 3,000 people.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests a gentle shift today, reminding us that even after the most turbulent storms pass, as seen in history's resilience against the gales of Honshu, beauty regrows. You may find it is a good time to clear your mental clutter. Consider how your meticulous nature can nurture new seeds of hope and quiet transformation today.
frase_do_dia: After the strongest winds, the most vibrant flowers bloom in the soft earth.
significado_numero: Represents the potential for personal growth and finding harmony in transition.
conselho: Trust your inner compass and embrace the calm that follows every internal challenge.
